problem_statement: Vinit Shahdeo's Stellar Astro portfolio has a strong dark personal-site shell (avatar nav, Home/About/Now/Featured/Practices/Books routes, an Ask AI action, a hiring badge, real portrait/company/media imagery, and a flat Featured list of interviews and press). The proof of his open-source impact — GitHub Star recognition, GSoC mentorship, Postman/Novo/ZZAZZ work, community writing — is scattered across a long Featured feed with no way to navigate it by topic. Turn the Featured page into a real Proof library: a topic-filterable grid built from the existing featuredPosts data, with a chip row (All / Interviews / GitHub Star / Open Source / Engineering) that re-renders the article cards and updates a live 'Showing N of M articles' result count. Reuse the same proof-library control as a compact rail on Home and About so the impact story is continuous across pages. Keep the minimal dark #242424 / yellow #ffe895 / blue gradient visual language, the avatar nav, the compact max-w-2xl rhythm, rounded imagery, the mobile menu, and the About audio interaction. The chip row and card grid must wrap cleanly at 390px with no horizontal overflow, the active chip must stay legible, and clicking a topic must actually filter the cards and update the count.
required_content: Featured becomes a Proof library: a topic-filterable card grid built from the existing featuredPosts data, with an All / Interviews / GitHub Star / Open Source / Engineering chip row and a live 'Showing N of M articles' result count.
Clicking a topic chip re-renders the visible article cards and updates the count readout so it matches the cards shown (e.g. 'Showing 5 of 13 articles · GitHub Star').
The same proof-library control appears as a compact rail on Home and About, giving the open-source impact story a continuous presence across pages.
The active topic chip stays legible against the dark surface, and the card grid keeps stable, non-overlapping card dimensions consistent with the existing card treatment.
Existing routes, avatar nav, Ask AI action, hiring badge, source links, work history, and the About audio interaction remain available.
The proof-library chip row and card grid, mobile menu, and 390px layouts have no horizontal overflow, clipped cards, or overlapping text.
design_constraints: Preserve the Stellar portfolio identity: dark #242424 surface, muted gray body text, yellow #ffe895 accent chips/subtitles, blue gradient links, compact max-w-2xl content column, rounded cards, subtle #3a3a3a borders, and the small avatar nav.
Do not convert the portfolio into a bright SaaS landing page, a dashboard, or a card-heavy marketing site; it must still feel personal, minimal, and editorial.
Build the proof library from the existing featuredPosts data and real publisher/date metadata; do not invent unrelated stock content.
Proof cards must have restrained density, stable dimensions, readable metadata, and consistent border/radius treatment; the active filter chip must have legible contrast.
Keep the About music interaction and image hover effects usable; the proof-library control must not remove the audio surprise or work/connect sections.
Keep the mobile Menu button and dropdown behavior recognizable, with Home/About/Now/Featured/Practices/Books/Ask AI still reachable.
state_constraints: desktop_initial captures the home hero, avatar nav, hiring badge, social links, and the compact proof-library rail.
desktop_about captures the About page with the proof-library rail alongside the biography, image pair, and audio interaction.
desktop_featured captures the Proof library card grid built from the featuredPosts data.
desktop_featured_ghstar captures the Featured page after clicking the GitHub Star topic chip: the grid re-filters and the count readout updates.
mobile_initial, mobile_menu_open, and mobile_featured capture responsive states that must remain clean with no horizontal overflow.

change_completion: Featured is a working Proof library with an All / Interviews / GitHub Star / Open Source / Engineering chip row and a live 'Showing N of M articles' count.
Clicking a topic chip filters the visible cards and updates the count so it matches the cards actually shown.
The proof-library control is reused as a compact rail on Home and About for a continuous cross-page impact story.
Existing routes, avatar nav, Ask AI, source links, work history, and the About audio interaction remain available.
design_consistency: The proof library matches the dark minimal Stellar visual system: accent chips, gradient links, rounded cards, borders, and spacing rhythm.
The active topic chip is legible and cards keep stable, non-overlapping dimensions.
The site remains personal/editorial rather than turning into a generic dashboard.
regression: Home, About, Featured, Now, Practices, Books, Ask AI, social links, work history, and featured posts are not removed.
External article/source links still open externally and internal nav stays consistent.
responsive: Mobile home, menu-open, and featured states have no horizontal overflow and keep all routes reachable.
The proof-library chip row and article cards wrap cleanly at 390px width.

author_notes: Repo-grounded Astro modify/cross_page task on Vinit Shahdeo's Stellar dark portfolio. The native lever is the Featured grid's own topic filter — a proof-library chip row (All / Interviews / GitHub Star / Open Source / Engineering) that re-renders the article cards and updates a live result count, reused as a compact rail on Home and About for cross-page continuity. Runability passes with npm install and a static astro build served from dist. Captures show a polished dark portfolio with real proof imagery, the filterable proof library, and a functional mobile menu.
